title: She Owes $0 and Still Has No Credit Score. Here's Why
summary: Maya has never owed anyone a dollar, and the electric company still wants a $300 deposit because she has no credit score. This video explains what a credit score actually measures, the five FICO ingredients (payment history, amounts owed, length of history, new credit, credit mix), utilization, hard vs soft inquiries, how to build a score from zero without paying interest, how to read your reports for free, and why 'carry a balance' is a myth. Deposit and card amounts are made-up examples; the car loan example uses average used-car rates by credit tier from early 2026, and real offers depend on the lender. Maya and Jordan are fictional composites.
